prompt: A contact sheet of six separate food photographs arranged in a strict grid of 3 columns by 2 rows, each subject centred in its own invisible square cell of equal size (cells are 768 by 768 px), on one continuous seamless flat matte warm cream ground (#F4E6C4), with no lines, borders or labels between cells and a generous empty margin (at least 12 percent) around each subject so nothing touches a cell edge. All six shot identically: three-quarter elevated angle (about 40 degrees), soft warm daylight from the upper left, very soft short contact shadow under each item, the same sharp realistic editorial food-photography look, real appetising colours. Crockery: matte deep forest-green (#233929) ceramic, off-white ceramic, brushed steel. The reference image only shows the look of the bowl, light and food realism: do not copy its composition or ground colour. Cells, left to right, top row then bottom row: (1) salade Raja: a wide shallow green bowl of fresh salad with sliced tandoori chicken tikka, crisp lettuce, tomato, cucumber, red onion, a drizzle of white yoghurt-mint dressing; (2) salade Rani: a wide shallow green bowl of fresh vegetarian salad with golden crushed samosa pieces, chickpeas, tomato, cucumber, grated carrot, pomegranate seeds and a green chutney drizzle; (3) agneau madras: green bowl of deep red-orange lamb curry with tender lamb pieces, curry leaves, beside a mound of basmati rice on a steel plate; (4) agneau shahi korma: green bowl of creamy pale golden lamb korma with lamb pieces, flaked almonds and golden raisins, beside a mound of basmati rice on a steel plate; (5) daal tarka: green bowl of golden-yellow lentil and tomato curry with a spiced oil tempering of cumin and red chilli on top and coriander, beside basmati rice on a steel plate; (6) aubergine massala: green bowl of smoky roasted aubergine in a red tomato-onion masala with chopped coriander, beside basmati rice on a steel plate. Absolutely no text, no letters, no logos, no printed packaging, no hands, no people. Original images, not copies of any brand's photos.
